smoke_target.note: Do not hardcode in product; use in live smoke only with user-provided token

phases.goal: Harden VK credentials: require numeric group_id; store meta.group_id
actions: Require group_id for ChannelType.vk (non-empty digits)
Reject missing/invalid group_id with 422 validation_error field=group_id
Strip whitespace on access_token; keep Fernet encrypt path
Ensure GET public_meta exposes group_id, never access_token
checks: pytest: vk with group_id+token → 201; GET has no token fields, has group_id in meta or public fields
phases.expected_result: API accepts only complete VK connect payload
phases.rollback: Revert channel_service validation to optional group_id

actions: Add backend/app/services/adapters/vk.py: supports_autopost=True
health: GET api.vk.com/method/groups.getById group_id=meta.group_id + token; map errors to ChannelHealth
publish: wall.post owner_id=-{group_id} from_group=1 message=social_post text; guid=idempotency_key if set
external_url https://vk.com/wall-{gid}_{post_id}
Map flood/captcha/too many → rate_limited retryable; auth/access → non-retryable
Empty text → AdapterError validation non-retryable
redact_secret on all logged/returned error strings
Wire get_adapter(vk) → VkAdapter; remove ManualCopy for vk
httpx timeout; fixed host api.vk.com only; API version e.g. 5.199
checks: unit/mock: empty text no HTTP call
pytest replace test_vk_stays_manual_copy with autopost expectations under mock
phases.expected_result: Worker can autopost text to VK via mocked HTTP
phases.contingency: If VK error envelope unexpected, log error_code only and fail closed

phases.goal: UI: VK in connect + plan/editor/calendar channel pickers
actions: MVP_CHANNELS include vk (order: telegram, vk, gmail or telegram, gmail, vk — prefer telegram, vk, gmail)
ChannelsPage form: group_id + access_token (password) when type=vk
Labels CHANNEL_LABELS.vk already exists
Empty-state hint mentions VK
vitest: secrets not rendered; vk option present
phases.expected_result: User can select VK in UI and save credentials fields

actions: Run pytest test_ac_channels + test_ac_publish (+ new vk tests)
Run vitest touched suites
Confirm TG/Gmail paths unchanged
Confirm wordpress/instagram still ManualCopy
Document: no live VK in CI (mock only)
Verify no token in GET/logs/UI
Verify only api.vk.com host
pdn_consent still required
checks: GATE_PASS or middle+ fixes by coder
phases.expected_result: No secret leak / no open URL SSRF

phases.goal: Simplify pass on new VK surface
actions: Check duplication vs telegram http client; no over-abstraction

phases.goal: Commit, push, deploy VPS; optional live smoke
actions: Commit relevant files only (no .env, no token)
Push origin/main
Deploy: ssh update-vps.sh or deploy-vps.sh
curl health 200
Manual smoke (user): connect VK with group_id 241074885 + token; Health ok; schedule one social_post; confirm wall post
checks: Live smoke: wall post appears OR document blocked if token invalid
phases.rollback: Revert commit or hotfix ManualCopy + hide vk from MVP_CHANNELS; redeploy
phases.contingency: If api.vk.com blocked from VPS — report; do not add random proxies without design

acceptance: Channels dropdown includes VK with group_id + access_token fields
Prod deploy health 200; user can connect club241074885
coding_loop: After each VK-1..3: coder → then continue; after VK-3 full loop qa → security → simplify → devops
